description: List checkpoint packets newest-first (filter with composeJobId for one run's v1→vN gate history, or projectId). The version stack with per-version status + decisions IS the review history — nothing is deleted.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.nextCursor`. Forward-only.

composeJobId.description: Scope to ONE compose run — its v1→vN gate history with per-version status and decisions.

limit.description: Page size (1..100), default 20. Out-of-range or unparseable clamps into the range.

projectId.description: Scope to everything reviewable in one project.

name: list_checkpoints
title: List Checkpoints
